dialogues.speaker: Araphala
dialogues.text: I gave several Unrivaled Fresh Fruits to sister, she is less angry after eating them.

dialogues.speaker: Araphala
dialogues.text: Last time she was angry, was when we made all that smoke in Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Araphala
dialogues.text: Araphala will give her more Unrivaled Fresh Fruits, when that happens again...
